title: Remove Subclass

solutions.title: A boolean field where the subclass used to be
solutions.tradeoff: TrialStudent's file and name disappear, so a future trial-only rule has no ready-made home to grow into - it has to earn a new subclass, or a new branch, from scratch.

reviewFocus: Does TrialStudent still exist anywhere in the solution, even unused - including a file this task did not touch?
Is `trial` read in exactly one place in the solution (Student itself), or does some caller still branch on it directly?
Was the trial discount's rounding (Math.round, half-away-from-zero) preserved exactly, or did the collapse quietly change it to a truncation?
Does kindLabel() still return the same two strings, 'Regular' and 'Trial', unchanged from outside?
Compare against drill-12-06 (Replace Type Code with Subclasses, the inverse move): does the walkthrough actually explain when each direction is the right call, or only assert that this one is?
